name: 2026–2027 JCT MBA resume template

provenance.authority: User-provided reference template; institutional publication status was not independently verified.
provenance.dateBasis: Creation and modification dates are stored DOCX metadata, not a verified publication date. The filename suffix is preserved without interpreting it as a date.
provenance.paragraphReferenceConvention: One-based top-level w:body/w:p positions in word/document.xml, including empty spacer paragraphs.
provenance.sanitization: Author names, local absolute paths, template contact values, example applicant facts, revision identifiers, and embedded personal/example hyperlink targets are omitted.

layout.observedPageCountBasis: Stored docProps/app.xml Pages value; not independently confirmed by a faithful paginated render.
layout.bodyFontBasis: Visible text runs declare Calibri; their size inherits the 24-half-point document default. The Normal style does not override that size.
layout.documentDefaultFontNote: The default family is overridden by Calibri on visible text runs; it is not the observed body family.
layout.spacingNote: No explicit spacing or line-height value is declared for the body/Normal paragraphs. Blank paragraphs provide section separation.

sectionPolicy: Optional flags reflect the template's labels. Other sections are present in the scaffold, but the file does not explicitly state that every applicant must include each one.

rules.label: Emphasize accomplishments
rules.guidance: Describe accomplishments and results rather than listing job duties.

rules.label: Start with action verbs
rules.guidance: Begin accomplishment and project bullets with action verbs.

rules.label: Use past tense for accomplishments
rules.guidance: Use past-tense verbs when describing what you have accomplished.

rules.label: Quantify results
rules.guidance: Quantify accomplishments and project results where possible.

rules.label: Use relevant keywords
rules.guidance: Include keywords that help a recruiter recognize relevant experience.

rules.label: Prioritize relevant accomplishments
rules.guidance: Emphasize accomplishments relevant to the job you want.

rules.label: Be concise and specific
rules.guidance: Remove unnecessary words and sentences while keeping concrete information.

rules.label: Avoid first-person pronouns
rules.guidance: Write experience and project descriptions without I, me, or my.

rules.label: Add company context when useful
rules.guidance: An optional one-line explanation may describe a less-recognized business and its scale.

rules.label: Avoid repeating the same employer
rules.guidance: For another position with the same employer, omit the repeated employer name and location.

rules.label: Explain each project briefly
rules.guidance: Introduce a project with a one-line explanation.

rules.label: Use two or three project bullets
rules.guidance: Use two or three bullets to describe your contribution and results.

rules.label: Coursework is optional
rules.guidance: If included, select coursework relevant to the job and subjects you can discuss confidently.

rules.label: Keep undergraduate leadership brief
rules.guidance: Highlight major undergraduate leadership activities or achievements in one line.

rules.label: Keep club lists compact
rules.guidance: Separate listed clubs with semicolons or commas.

rules.label: Technical proficiency is optional
rules.guidance: Include technical proficiency when relevant; the template offers technical skills, languages, and certifications as categories.

rules.label: Choose distinguishing interests
rules.guidance: Use Additional Information for personal interests that distinguish you; commas may separate items.

rules.label: Include service or other leadership
rules.guidance: Additional Information may include volunteer service and other leadership activities.

rules.label: Follow the template section order
rules.guidance: The template places Education, optional Technical Proficiency, Professional Experience, Projects, and Additional Information in that order.

rules.label: Observed body font
rules.guidance: Visible text in this file is configured as Calibri 12 pt.

rules.label: Observed page size
rules.guidance: This file uses US Letter portrait pages, 612 by 792 points.

rules.label: Observed margins
rules.guidance: The file declares 0.70-inch top, 0.50-inch right, 0.55-inch bottom, and 0.50-inch left margins.

rules.label: Observed headings
rules.guidance: The name and section headings are centered and bold; section headings are uppercase.

rules.label: Observed contact arrangement
rules.guidance: A centered contact line follows the name and offers location, phone, email, and LinkedIn fields separated by vertical bars.

rules.label: Observed date style
rules.guidance: Education and role entries use month/year date fields; roles display start and end dates.

rules.label: Observed experience arrangement
rules.guidance: The scaffold starts with the most recent job title and then presents prior employers.

rules.label: Stored one-page metadata
rules.guidance: Word metadata records one page. The template does not state a written page limit, and rendered pagination has not been confirmed.

implementationRecommendations: Separate template instructions, observed formatting, and measurements of an uploaded resume in the review interface.
Treat observed font, margins, and page count as reference comparisons, not verified institutional requirements.
PDF glyph-box bounds estimate occupied text area; they do not prove the DOCX's page margins. Do not compare them as identical measurements.
Do not treat missing optional Technical Proficiency or coursework as an error.
Only suggest quantified achievements supported by the student's supplied evidence; ask for missing metrics instead of inventing numbers.
Do not infer any student's degree, STEM designation, graduation date, employers, projects, interests, memberships, contact details, or certifications from template placeholders.
Use only student-confirmed contact links. The template contains an embedded LinkedIn target that must not be copied into another applicant's resume.
Do not apply the past-tense instruction as a categorical ban on present-tense descriptions of ongoing work.
If generating a future resume, use explicit layout settings and semantic tab stops rather than copying repeated spaces or relying on this template's renderer-dependent tab layout.
Normalize instructional typos in displayed guidance without presenting the normalization as a new institutional rule.
Do not require the example Product Studio project for every student, or fetch the embedded project-example link automatically.

verification.structuralMethod: ZIP part inspection with unzip, xmllint, and XSLT; font inheritance, section geometry, numbering, relationships, metadata, and all 47 body paragraphs inspected.
verification.visibleInstructionCoverage: All template body text inspected, including Projects and Additional Information.
verification.canonicalRenderLimitation: The required workspace document dependency loader was unavailable and LibreOffice was not installed.
verification.previewMethod: macOS Quick Look thumbnail, visually inspected.
previewFindings: The preview displays a serif face despite Calibri declarations in OOXML.
Location and date fields wrap inconsistently because the template uses repeated spaces and default tabs.
The thumbnail clips lower content and cannot confirm complete pagination.
verification.interpretation: Use OOXML for declared formatting tokens. Quick Look provides limited visual context only; do not claim the template passed full render verification.
